name: Inhospitableness
overview: Scripture presents inhospitableness as a serious barrier to fellowship and blessing, exemplified by various peoples who refused passage or hospitality to Israel and others. Edom and Sihon denied Israel safe passage through their lands, even preparing for battle rather than allowing them to pass peacefully. Similarly, the Ammonites and Moabites were excluded from the congregation of the LORD due to longstanding enmity. Instances of inhospitable behavior also appear in the personal realm, such as the men of Gibeah refusing lodging to a Levite, Nabal's harshness toward David, and some Samaritans rejecting Jesus because of His mission to Jerusalem. These accounts reveal that inhospitableness disrupts God's purposes and reflects a hardened heart opposed to His people and His work.
